content.text:
The site looked wrong because the custom web font wasn't loading. I fixed it, and all the visual and functional tests now pass.

**Cause:** the `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The font request failed, so every page fell back to the system font. That changed text widths and wrapping across the whole site.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. That one line is the only change, and I haven't committed it.

**Tests:**
- Visual: all 12 comparisons (6 pages at desktop and phone size) failed before the fix and pass now.
- Functional: all 16 pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the wrong path.

STATUS: DONE
